name: E.B. Blueberries Inc.
tagline: E.B. Blueberry Farm In Imlay City MI
description: In Imlay City, MI, E.B. Blueberries Inc. raises Blueberries on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
